subject.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning

question: Should OpenClaw permanently add `session.maintenance.pruned` to the diagnostic event contract and publish the two proposed counter names?
rationale: The implementation is technically narrow, but the event union and operator metric names become compatibility-sensitive public surfaces that automation cannot accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Sponsor the additive contract
options.body: Accept the count-only trusted event and metric names, then merge after the catalog correction, real-Gateway proof, and required checks are clean.

options.title: Decline the new contract
options.body: Keep pruning as log-only observability or close the proposal if maintainers do not want another permanent diagnostic event and metric pair.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the count-only trusted event and metric names, then merge after the catalog correction, real-Gateway proof, and required checks are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to adjacent cron contracts and diagnostics behavior, making them the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
